**Step Number**: Step 10  
**Reason for Mistake**: The Planner agent misinterpreted the death date of Léon Joannon (March 28, 1969) as being "March 28, 1996." This error resulted from either misidentification of the death year in the extracted data or a typographical error during transcription. This factual error later led to an incorrect comparison where the Planner concluded that Léon Joannon died later than John Sturges (who actually died in 1992), which was not true. The mistake could have been avoided by cross-checking the death year of Léon Joannon in the multiple data sources already retrieved or validating the information with more precision.
